title: What Was Written vs. Who Read It: News Media Profiling Using Text Analysis and Social Media Context

bias_targets.methodology: Training Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifiers using multi-modal features extracted from published news articles (textual features via BERT and NELA), social media audience contexts (Twitter follower biographies, Facebook audience political leaning estimates, and YouTube metadata), and Wikipedia descriptions to classify the political ideology of news media outlets on a left-center-right spectrum.
